name: The Second Sight: The Devil and the Wheel
storyline:
You’re a psychic. A Psion. An urban legend among urban legends. Your adopted father has always done his best to shield you from the hidden world, which exists in the shadow of the mundane, but as the old adage goes, once you become aware of the supernatural, it becomes aware of you.

You’ve already confronted the Courts, bargained with the Unseelie, and come out the victor. Now, there is no way to go but forward and for you that means a new case.

Witch society is caught in a perpetual war with its own identity; torn between antiquated social mores and the ever-changing nature of its own subjects. When a prominent, magical scholar goes missing, you find yourself performing a dangerous balancing act for an unforgiving audience.

But like most of the supernatural, not everything is as it seems. Not every monster wears its true nature on its face and our greatest hurdles are often of our own making.
